method: Local AV file path, separate audio and visual distributions. Duration × input quality among eligible observations. Each native ranking compared to the same take's unique plurality of 10 original audio-only or video-only votes. Check top score versus perceived intensity (ten modality-specific 1-5 ratings) for all clips with an output. Full model vocabularies retained. Tied votes excluded per modality. 8 clips per held-out actor, normal intensity, acted neutral/happy/angry/surprised. No fitting or threshold selection; upstream training overlap unknown.
